scope: Six curated, independently useful service/locality landing pages; no automatic service-by-city multiplication.

evidenceClasses.A: Observed own website/Search Console signal or official rule; historical observations are not current forecasts.
evidenceClasses.D: Commercial keyword-tool estimate or observed business search result; not independently confirmed search demand or profitability.

openSeo.connectivity: tools/list and list_saved_keywords succeeded; saved keyword list empty
openSeo.freshMetrics: get_keyword_metrics returned DataForSEO HTTP 402 on keyword_overview/live
openSeo.billingAction: No credits purchased, no credentials changed, no further blocked provider calls repeated.
openSeo.availableEvidence: Previous research retrieved 06.10.2026: 653 candidates, 84 returned rows, 74 positive estimated volumes. Underlying metric freshness unconfirmed.
openSeo.market: Germany locationCode 2276, language de. A location name inside the query is not a measurement of all searches originating in that locality.
openSeo.limits: Missing values are unknown, not zero. Broad Frankfurt volumes cannot be assigned to individual districts. Spelling variants must not be summed.

pages.intent: Recurring object-care contract for WEG, property managers and commercial buildings
pages.utility: Separate ownership of routine checks, defect reports, small tasks and specialist handovers; object-based plan and inquiry.

pages.intent: Cleaning-provider selection for common areas and mixed-use buildings
pages.utility: Room-group scope, access responsibility, occupancy windows and acceptance criteria; distinct from office-only and stairwell-only offerings.
Office cleaning windows, desk/record exclusions, key handling, sanitary and kitchen scope. District demand remains a pilot hypothesis.

pages.intent: Recurring communal-space cleaning contract for WEG and landlords
pages.utility: Stairwell-specific checklist, material-sensitive methods, resident coordination and clear inclusion/exclusion of basement, windows and lifts.
Site-specific surface plan, private access paths, obstructions, agreed trigger conditions and reporting; no municipal road work or blanket liability promise.

pages.intent: Tree work inquiry, inspected and scoped before acceptance
pages.utility: Access and tree-condition review, required permissions, safety area and optional separate waste removal; no unsupported climbing qualifications or emergency service.

measurement.search: Compare each exact landing URL's Search Console impressions, non-brand locality queries, clicks and CTR after Google has crawled it; no assumed indexing date.
measurement.conversion: Consent-gated generate_lead records only server-confirmed form acceptance. Phone clicks are separately measured, not completed calls. Qualify actual inquiries internally by service, location and contract fit.
measurement.expansionGate: Expand when locality can genuinely be served, the page has independent visitor utility and observed queries/inquiries support it. Do not infer success from page count or keyword density.
measurement.claims: No guarantees of ranking, indexing, inquiry count, turnaround time or legal compliance. One real business address in Sulzbach, no invented district offices or customer cases.
